title: WF03 f8 batch2 step4: runMigrations leaked duplicated migration-version keys when schema_migrations contained multi-schema duplicates
description: Step4 integration failures reported a large DebugAllocator leak chain rooted at tests/integration/helpers.zig:runMigrations while initializing TestHarness for TC-SPT-01-08. The leak originated in the migration-version cache build path.
root_cause: runMigrations queried all schema_migrations rows by version only. After schema-per-tenant expansion, the same migration version appears multiple times across schemas. The helper duplicated each version string before map insertion, and duplicate keys were discarded by the hash map without freeing the newly allocated copy, creating a large allocator leak cascade.
error_detail: [DebugAllocator] leaked allocations from allocator.dupe at tests/integration/helpers.zig:105 in runMigrations, surfaced during TestHarness.init for TC-SPT-01-08.
resolution: Added a pre-insert dedupe guard in runMigrations: if applied.contains(ver) continue before allocator.dupe. This prevents duplicate key allocations for repeated version rows while preserving migration-skip behavior.
prevention: When caching DB strings in hash maps, check key existence before allocating owned copies (or use insertion APIs that expose ownership semantics) to avoid duplicate-key allocation leaks under expanded datasets.
